Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class CompositeWindowImageLoader

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.CompositeWindowImageLoader
All Implemented Interfaces:
TiledNativeWindowImageLoader, WindowPixelSource
public class CompositeWindowImageLoader extends Object implements TiledNativeWindowImageLoader, WindowPixelSource
Pure-Java pixel pipeline from a Composite offscreen pixmap into the TiledNativeWindowImage tiles that back a NativeWindow3D.

This is the compositing replacement for the legacy fws/x11/ImageLoader + ImageUpdater (LightPipe / native) path. It implements the same TiledNativeWindowImageLoader contract so it plugs into TiledNativeWindowImage.fillTiles(org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.TiledNativeWindowImageLoader, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.fws.WindowContents) unchanged, but instead of a native updater it reads pixels with core XGetImage (Drawable.image(int, int, int, int, int, int)) from the window's CompositeNameWindowPixmap and blits them into each tile's BufferedImage.

Data flow

  1. X11Compositor receives a DamageNotify for a window and calls the registered X11Compositor.DamageListener.
  2. The listener (Stage 4 wiring) calls updateRegion(org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.TiledNativeWindowImage, int, int, int, int, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.fws.WindowContents) with the damaged rectangle.
  3. updateRegion delegates to TiledNativeWindowImage.fillTiles(TiledNativeWindowImageLoader, int, int, int, int, WindowContents), which calls loadTile(org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.ImageComponent2D, int, int, int, int, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.fws.WindowContents) for each affected tile.
  4. loadTile reads the region from the Composite pixmap and updates the tile's image, triggering a texture re-upload on the next rendered frame.

Pixel format

Pixels are read as a ZPixmap and decoded using the window's TrueColor red/green/blue masks (defaulting to the standard 24-bit layout). The per-scanline stride honours the server's bits-per-pixel and scanline-pad for the pixmap's depth, and the byte assembly honours Display.image_byte_order.

Threading

loadTile(org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.ImageComponent2D, int, int, int, int, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.fws.WindowContents) performs a synchronous X round-trip and must therefore run on the X11WindowManager event thread (or another thread that safely serializes access to the shared Display), not on the Java 3D rendering thread.

      public BufferedImage readRegion(int x, int y, int width, int height)
      Reads a rectangular region of this window's redirected Composite pixmap into a BufferedImage, or returns null if the window is not (yet) redirected or the read failed. This is the WindowPixelSource entry point: the shared source both the 3D texture path (via updateRegion(org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.TiledNativeWindowImage, int, int, int, int, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.fws.WindowContents)) and the 2D Swing path (via CompositedWindowPipeline) read pixels through.
      Specified by:
      readRegion in interface WindowPixelSource
      Parameters:
      x - region left, in window pixels
      y - region top, in window pixels
      width - region width, in pixels
      height - region height, in pixels
      Returns:
      the decoded region, or null if the window is not (yet) redirected, the geometry is empty, or the read failed (the next damage event retries)
